text:
zoe: Postmortem follow-up for the 00:30 UTC noise spike. Short summary + owners.

zoe: What happened: scheduled maintenance jobs retried after a transient S3 error, producing a flood of P4 alerts. Dedupe missed because fingerprint used unique run_id; routing went to global-sre instead of storage-owner.

zoe: Action items (owners + brief targets):
- mike -> update alert thresholds (increase timeouts, add derivative rule) (target: Thu EOD)
- anu -> change dedupe fingerprint to include job_name + error_code and extend window to 20m (target: Mon)
- ravi -> routing change so storage.* -> storage-owner, fallback to global-sre after 30m (target: Fri)
- all -> add suppression rule for maintenance_label==true behind a feature flag (target: Fri)

mike: taking thresholds. initial plan: raise timeout from 30s->120s for backfills and add a 5m derivative to catch ramps.

anu: dedupe plan: fingerprint=hash(job_name,error_code,cluster), window=20m. will open PR and test in staging.

ravi: routing: will update routing-config and run a canary for storage-east. fallback after 30m remains.

oncall-bot: ticket created PM-9177 "Alert tuning: maintenance job noise" assigned to @mike @anu @ravi  https://issues.redwood.example/PM-9177

zoe: please drop 1-line status updates here so I can roll into the remediation tracker.

mike: status: baseline collected; proposing threshold=150s + derivative rule. will open PR tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

anu: status: PR #533 opened in observability; staging replay shows ~81% duplicate reduction. :construction:

ravi: status: routing PR drafted; canary scheduled Sat 02:00 UTC.

zoe: next steps: if staging looks good, plan prod flip Mon 02:00 UTC. I'll add 20 sample traces to Redwood Optimize eval to watch for suppressed real incidents.

mike: will add traces to the Optimize eval set.

anu: if duplicates persist above 20% after 1w, we'll iterate on grouping and consider adding attempt_number bucketing.

ravi: will update PM-9177 after canary and prod flip.

zoe: final: update PM-9177 with prod status and close when all owners confirm. also adding an incident signature (owner: zoe) to recurring-incidents so detectors can catch this pattern. thanks team :thumbsup:
